lists.content: Ready to turn your passion for technology into a career? As an apprentice Informatiker/-in EFZ Applikationsentwicklung, you'll learn how modern software is built, improved, and scaled alongside experienced engineers. From your very first projects, you'll contribute to a product used by thousands of people around the world, gaining hands-on experience while building the skills that will shape your future. Whether you choose to focus on your apprenticeship or complete your vocational baccalaureate (Berufsmaturität) alongside it, we'll support your learning journey. Over the course of this four-year apprenticeship, you'll grow into a confident software developer while working as part of one of our product teams.

• You'll collaborate with one of our product development teams on real software projects.

  • You'll help design and build new product features.

  • You'll troubleshoot, test, and fix software bugs.

  • You'll learn modern development practices and contribute to the day-to-day work of an engineering team.

• You're able to spend your working days in our St. Gallen office, where you'll receive hands-on support, learn alongside experienced colleagues, and gain valuable exposure to teams across the business.

  • You're excited to start your career in software development and eager to learn.

  • You have strong communication skills in German and English.

  • You think logically, work in a structured way, and enjoy solving problems.

  • You're curious, patient, and enjoy collaborating with others.

  • You're completing Secondary School Level A with strong results in mathematics.

    • If you'd like to pursue a vocational baccalaureate (Berufsmaturität) alongside your apprenticeship, we'll support you in making it happen.

lists.content:
• Identify, convert and onboard consultancy partners that align with Frontify's growth priorities.

  • Build trusted relationships with current and new partners working across digital transformation (including DAM) and brand technology.

  • Develop and track business plans and partner motions that drive revenue, pipeline, and awareness.

  • Co-ordinate partner enablement so consultancies and integrators can confidently position, demo, and implement Frontify.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a smooth partner experience.

  • Track partner performance and use data to inform priorities, improvements, and growth opportunities.

  • Represent Frontify at conferences and industry events.

  • Contribute ideas that strengthen our ecosystem and help us scale.

• You’re comfortable working in a hybrid format, with the ability to come to our New York office twice per week.

  • You have 5+ years of experience in a new business focused role, managing partnerships within digital transformation, or SaaS with a strong track record of building and growing partner relationships. 

  • You have a strong grasp of the DAM ecosystem.

  • You understand the consultancy landscape and know how these partners influence enterprise buying and implementation decisions.

  • You enjoy building relationships with senior stakeholders and can navigate complex organizations with confidence.

  • You're comfortable balancing partner management, pipeline growth, and internal alignment.

  • A good understanding of AI and how it can be applied in modern digital experiences.

  • You think commercially and know how to turn strategy into action.

  • You communicate clearly and work well across functions.

  • Experience in partner enablement, go-to-market planning, and technical solution selling is a plus.

We're looking for a midweight maker who thinks like a creative, but isn’t allergic to systems. Your inclination is to focus on the idea — what we’re inviting our audiences to consider the thing that makes someone take notice, the signs of life behind a piece of communication. You'll join our in-house studio to help us take the everyday output (external- and internal-facing) of a scale-up organization and make it genuinely interesting. 
This isn't a leadership role. We're not expecting you to own projects end-to-end or manage stakeholders solo. What we need is a sharp creative generalist who can jump into any brief, bring ideas to the table, execute it well, and make everything around you better. You'll work alongside creative leads, designers, and writers, contributing ideas and craft rather than running the show.
 You'll get the variety and creative energy of agency work without the constant pitching and client churn — plus the stability and context of being embedded in one organization. You'll never be short of interesting problems to solve.

descriptionPlain:
We're all about helping brands turn ideas into impact.

Frontify’s brand platform transforms how teams organize digital assets, collaborate on projects, and create engaging campaigns. Our people empower thousands of marketers and designers — including teams at Uber, Microsoft, Volkswagen, and Telefónica — to build engaging brands.

With headquarters in St. Gallen, Switzerland, and offices in London and New York City, we share a vibrant culture built on creativity, collaboration, inclusion, and joy. And we’re on the lookout for new team members to share our vision. If you’re ready for a brand-new adventure, keep reading!

Your team
They’re international, motivated, ambitious, supportive, and on both sides of the Atlantic. More than that, they’re a community of collaborative thrivers who aim to conquer the branding world. Your team isn’t just focused on booking their next meeting; they're motivated by the shared desire to have an impact, grow together and generate value for the wider business.


Your mission
As a Sales Development Representative for the DACH market, you'll be responsible for generating leads through outbound efforts. You’ll be the first point of contact for potential customers, sparking interest in our platform through thoughtful, targeted, and tailored outbound outreach. Your goal is to generate high-quality leads, start meaningful conversations, and create excitement around how Frontify can help businesses strengthen their brand management.

lists.content:
• You'll generate qualified leads within new accounts, driving growth in the sales pipeline.   
  • You'll strategically prospect enterprise clients through personalized cold calls, emails, and multi-touch campaigns.  
  • You'll collaborate with Account Executives to identify and develop high-potential opportunities. 
  • You’ll proactively anticipate objections and position tailored solutions to drive qualified prospects into the sales cycle. 
  • You'll manage a high volume of target accounts with strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.  
  • You’ll synthesize complex information and make it digestible and relevant for executive buyers. 
  • You'll research and understand various lines of business, buyer personas, and their priorities. 
  • You’ll receive structured onboarding, enablement support, and ramping protection to ensure you’re set up for success as you grow into the role.

• You can work in a hybrid format where you’re able to work on-site in our London office twice a week, and then choose where works best for you for the rest of the week.  
  • You're a SaaS enthusiast and you're eager to grow and make an impact in an exciting sales opportunity. 
  • You're proactive and methodical in your work.  
  • Your talents include strong communication skills across multiple channels (phone, email, social media), resilience and perseverance, active listening and empathy, confidence and ownership, persuasion and negotiation, and the ability to handle objections and think on your feet.  
  • Your friends would describe you as honest, driven, and proactive.  
  • You speak English and German proficiently.

lists.content:
• You’ll implement high-quality features and improvements in a modern web application.

  • You’ll design solutions that ensure scalability, security, and maintainability.

  • You will collaborate with product management, design, and engineering toward viable product development changes from discovery to delivery.

  • You will work closely with other developers through pair programming, code reviews, and alike.

• You can work remotely from anywhere in Switzerland or join us on-site in our St. Gallen office, with the flexibility to choose your best work environment.

  • You're experienced in backend software engineering, while having basic frontend engineering knowledge is useful.

  • Ideally, you code with PHP or are willing to learn. Knowledge of TypeScript and other languages is welcome.

  • You love to write readable, reusable, scalable, and well-tested code.

  • You don't shy away from dealing with legacy code.

  • You fend off the dreaded 'big ball of mud' by keeping coupling low, cohesion high, and SOLID principles close at heart.

  • You hold strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • You have excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

  • You speak English fluently.

  • You'll manage the operational foundation of our allbound and ABM programs, maintaining target account lists, intent data, account scoring, and the workflows that connect marketing activity with CRM and SDR execution.

  • You'll own advertising operations, ensuring campaigns are correctly configured, tracked, and measured so performance data is reliable, attributable, and actionable.

  • You'll manage the technical implementation of personalized content experiences, ensuring they're configured correctly, aligned with campaign objectives, and measured consistently.

  • You'll collaborate closely with the SDR team to ensure marketing signals, content, and account insights flow seamlessly into sales workflows, helping both teams stay aligned on prioritization, sequencing, and performance.

  • You'll continuously improve marketing processes, data quality, and operational workflows to help the business scale with confidence.

• You’re comfortable with a hybrid work model, spending two days per week in our London office.

  • You have experience partnering with SDR teams and supporting allbound go-to-market motions, understanding how marketing insights and content drive successful sales engagement.

  • You're highly organized and comfortable balancing multiple stakeholders, translating business needs into clear technical requirements while managing expectations effectively.

  • You naturally think in systems, take ownership of data quality, and understand that reliable data enables better business decisions.

  • You speak English fluently.

  • Maintain a strategic presence in the customer relationship, engaging directly at the executive level when the moment requires senior visibility or decisive action.

  • Design and execute regional CS strategies that align with global objectives and adapt to market needs.

  • Confident and clear communicator with proven success in executive-level discussions.

  • Collaborative leader who inspires trust, challenges constructively, and builds an inclusive, high-performance culture. 

  • Previous experience supporting customers in the Middle East and APAC regions would be beneficial.

Sitting at the intersection of brand, demand, partnerships, and revenue, you'll turn company priorities into meaningful market activations that build momentum across the US.

This is a role for someone who brings clarity to complexity. You'll translate strategy into programs that feel relevant, not repetitive — experiences that resonate with creative and marketing leaders while driving measurable pipeline impact. Working closely with Sales and cross-functional teams, you'll help define how our allbound motion comes to life in-market, strengthening relationships, unlocking opportunities, and making Frontify impossible to ignore.

lists.content:
• You’ll work alongside the wider marketing team to build and execute field marketing programs across our priority market the US, bringing deep expertise and sound judgment to every decision.

  • You'll turn company priorities into clear, market-facing plans that connect brand visibility, community, partnerships, and pipeline — and drive these through execution.

  • You'll develop and run events, tradeshows, and dinners that support both brand and commercial goals, owning the strategy-to-delivery lifecycle.

  • You'll ensure every initiative is well-managed, well-measured, and clearly tied to business outcomes — owning both the work and the proof.

  • This role is a chance to own how Frontify builds presence, relevance, and momentum in key markets. Your work won't just show up in campaigns — it will shape how customers experience the brand in the real world, and how that experience turns into lasting impact.

  • You understand Frontify's core audience — brand, creative, and marketing leaders — and know how to engage them with relevant, high-impact programs.

  • You think strategically but stay close to execution, knowing that great ideas only matter if they land in-market.

  • You're confident operating across multiple regions, with the ability to focus effort where it drives the most impact.

  • You bring strong cross-functional instincts and enjoy connecting the dots across teams to create something bigger than the sum of its parts.

  • You're motivated by building — from shaping new approaches to refining what works into scalable systems — and you find real satisfaction in ownership and expertise.

  • You have a track record of raising the bar for how work gets done, whether through mentoring colleagues, establishing best practices, or modeling excellence in execution.

Your mission
As a Technical Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the trusted technical problem-solver our customers reach for when something is in their way. You'll resolve issues with speed and care across email, chat, and the occasional call — from everyday product questions to hands-on SSO and custom domain setups — and you'll make sure every customer leaves an interaction feeling looked after, not just closed out.
Just as importantly, you'll help our support system get smarter over time: improving our knowledge base, sharpening what our AI tooling can resolve on its own, and turning recurring problems into permanent fixes.
Your responsibilities
Be the technical front line
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking technical assistance through Intercom (email and chat), and be available for occasional calls for technical setups.
Provide timely, professional, genuinely helpful responses — troubleshooting issues and resolving them to the customer's satisfaction.
Maintain a customer-centric approach throughout every interaction, not just until the ticket closes.
Troubleshoot and resolve at the root
Diagnose and analyze reported issues, identify the root cause, and implement effective solutions.
Provide clear workarounds where a full fix isn't immediately available, and report bugs with the detail Engineering needs to act.
Partner with Engineering, Product, and subject-matter experts to resolve complex or escalated issues.
Document your troubleshooting steps and solutions so the whole team benefits.
Own technical setups
Coordinate and implement Custom Domain and SSO/SAML setups for customers, including certificate handling and renewals.
Drive setups to timely completion against go-live dates and customer deadlines, and troubleshoot setup issues when they arise.
Escalate well
Escalate critical or high-impact issues to senior support or Engineering at the right moment, with the context needed for a fast resolution.
Keep customers informed on progress and expected timelines throughout an escalation.
Make support smarter with AI and self-service
Work alongside our AI support tooling (Fin and related automation), spotting where it falls short and feeding back the gaps so it resolves more on its own over time.
Proactively educate customers on self-help resources.
Build the knowledge ecosystem
Create and maintain support documentation — FAQs, knowledge base articles, and troubleshooting guides — that compounds in value with every interaction.
Share knowledge and best practices with teammates to raise the whole team's technical capability.
Drive quality and continuous improvement
Uphold our quality standards across every interaction, and take part in regular quality reviews and training.
Surface recurring issues and patterns, and turn them into process improvements rather than repeated tickets.
Handle sensitive customer data in line with our security and compliance protocols.
Your story
You speak German and English fluently
You're based in Switzerland and able to work hybrid from our St Gallen office - 2 days a week.
You have experience in a technical, customer-facing support role, within a SaaS company, and are comfortable owning issues end to end.
You have real technical aptitude — you're comfortable with concepts like SSO/SAML, DNS and custom domains, APIs, and web
technologies, and you enjoy learning the next layer.
You've worked in a modern support tooling environment (Intercom or similar) and are excited to work alongside AI and automation, not threatened by it.
You have a genuine instinct for customer experience — you care about how customers feel, not just whether the ticket closed.
You think in systems and solve problems at the root, and you document as you go.
You're a clear, confident communicator with both customers and internal technical teams.

How we'll measure success
High customer satisfaction across your interactions.
Technical setups completed on time, against customer go-live deadlines.
Growing self-service and AI deflection driven by the knowledge and feedback you contribute.

With headquarters in St. Gallen, Switzerland, and offices in London and New York City, we share a vibrant culture built on creativity, collaboration, inclusion, and joy. And we're on the lookout for new team members to share our vision. If you're ready for a brand-new adventure, keep reading!

Your mission

As a Technical Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the trusted technical problem-solver our customers reach for when something is in their way. You'll resolve issues with speed and care across email, chat, and the occasional call — from everyday product questions to hands-on SSO and custom domain setups — and you'll make sure every customer leaves an interaction feeling looked after, not just closed out.

Just as importantly, you'll help our support system get smarter over time: improving our knowledge base, sharpening what our AI tooling can resolve on its own, and turning recurring problems into permanent fixes.

Your responsibilities

Be the technical front line

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking technical assistance through Intercom (email and chat), and be available for occasional calls for technical setups.
  • Provide timely, professional, genuinely helpful responses — troubleshooting issues and resolving them to the customer's satisfaction.
  • Maintain a customer-centric approach throughout every interaction, not just until the ticket closes.

Troubleshoot and resolve at the root

  • Diagnose and analyze reported issues, identify the root cause, and implement effective solutions.
  • Provide clear workarounds where a full fix isn't immediately available, and report bugs with the detail Engineering needs to act.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and subject-matter experts to resolve complex or escalated issues.
  • Document your troubleshooting steps and solutions so the whole team benefits.

Own technical setups

  • Coordinate and implement Custom Domain and SSO/SAML setups for customers, including certificate handling and renewals.
  • Drive setups to timely completion against go-live dates and customer deadlines, and troubleshoot setup issues when they arise.

Escalate well

  • Escalate critical or high-impact issues to senior support or Engineering at the right moment, with the context needed for a fast resolution.
  • Keep customers informed on progress and expected timelines throughout an escalation.

Make support smarter with AI and self-service

  • Work alongside our AI support tooling (Fin and related automation), spotting where it falls short and feeding back the gaps so it resolves more on its own over time.
  • Proactively educate customers on self-help resources.

Build the knowledge ecosystem

  • Create and maintain support documentation — FAQs, knowledge base articles, and troubleshooting guides — that compounds in value with every interaction.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with teammates to raise the whole team's technical capability.

Drive quality and continuous improvement

  • Uphold our quality standards across every interaction, and take part in regular quality reviews and training.
  • Surface recurring issues and patterns, and turn them into process improvements rather than repeated tickets.
  • Handle sensitive customer data in line with our security and compliance protocols.

Your story

  • You speak German and English fluently
  • You're based in Switzerland and able to work hybrid from our St Gallen office - 2 days a week.
  • You have experience in a technical, customer-facing support role, within a SaaS company, and are comfortable owning issues end to end.
  • You have real technical aptitude — you're comfortable with concepts like SSO/SAML, DNS and custom domains, APIs, and web
  • technologies, and you enjoy learning the next layer.
  • You've worked in a modern support tooling environment (Intercom or similar) and are excited to work alongside AI and automation, not threatened by it.
  • You have a genuine instinct for customer experience — you care about how customers feel, not just whether the ticket closed.
  • You think in systems and solve problems at the root, and you document as you go.
  • You're a clear, confident communicator with both customers and internal technical teams.

How we'll measure success

  • High customer satisfaction across your interactions.
  • Technical setups completed on time, against customer go-live deadlines.
  • Growing self-service and AI deflection driven by the knowledge and feedback you contribute.

This role reports to the CPO/ CPTO and sits on the Product leadership team. Your closest partner is the VP of Product Engineering. You jointly set the priorities that determine where the platform invests, so the work you ship aligns with real product needs.

lists.content:
Strategic platform leadership

You bring a strategic lens to the platform org. Reading where teams lose time, you identify leverage points and turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap so the org invests in the highest-impact work first.

Tech debt is a deliberate choice in your hands. You make the technical calls that reduce friction and let product teams ship faster at higher quality.

The platform's security posture is yours. You surface platform-level vulnerabilities and close them before they become incidents.

The platform surfaces you're accountable for

  • Internal Developer platform (IDP) and tooling that lowers cognitive load for stream-aligned teams.
  • AI platform: model gateway over external providers, eval infrastructure, agent frameworks, LLM observability, safety controls.
  • Infrastructure, cloud, and DevOps: reliability, scalability, cost efficiency.
  • Frontend platform: design system, component library, shared build tooling.
  • Backend platform: shared services, APIs, data infrastructure.
  • Quality engineering: test automation, eval frameworks, quality standards.
  • Architecture and technical standards across the engineering org.
  • Security posture and platform-level vulnerabilities, ensuring they're accounted for and attended to.

    • What success looks like

  • You measure developer experience and act on what the numbers tell you.
  • Product teams spend more time on product and less on undifferentiated platform work.
  • AI tooling reaches everyday use across teams, and you can show where it saves time.
  • Tech debt stays under control, with a deliberate strategy for keeping it in check.
  • You track security and compliance gaps and close them on a known timeline.
  • Engineers choose to use the platform you build because it makes their work easier, not because policy forces them onto it.

• You can work remotely from anywhere within the EU, including the UK or join us on-site in our St. Gallen office, with the flexibility to choose your best work environment.
  • You've led platform or infrastructure engineering at scale, with 12+ years in engineering and 5+ years leading other leaders.
  • You've built or matured an internal developer platform that engineers have adopted by choice.
  • You're deeply versed in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, reliability, and cost management.
  • You've set architectural direction across multiple teams and made it stick.
  • You can reason about AI and LLM platform needs: gateways, evals, observability, and safety tooling.
  • You come from a background of fast-scaling SaaS product companies.
  • You stay curious about AI and experiment with it in how teams work.
  • You hire well, set clear standards, and give teams room to own their work.
  • You’re fluent in English.
